channel.title: NextXus Archives
channel.description: Dated milestones of the NextXus HumanCodex Federation.

item.title: Thirteen new Federation sites launched
item.description: Blog, Music, Tools, three build-service pages, Research Hub, Recycler, Chat, Senate, YAML Hub, Process and Archives went up on GitHub Pages in one build, all plain HTML and free to host.

item.title: Roger Sim AI goes live with 13 topics
item.guid: nextxus-archives:2026-09-30:Roger Sim AI goes live with 13 topics
item.description: The Sim now opens on Earth, fades in the face, and changes its backdrop to match what you talk about, using the 13-topic taxonomy v1.1.

item.title: Two-layer architecture written down
item.description: Every node has a silent technical layer that does the work and a voiced persona layer that talks to people. The two are never merged.

item.title: Paid newsletter platform removed
item.description: The Federation stopped using an outside newsletter service. The Federation Press Corps already publishes on free GitHub Pages.

item.title: Book catalog listed on Gumroad
item.description: New book PDFs were produced and listed for sale. Gumroad is the source of truth for every product's title, price and description.

item.title: Federation Portal on GitHub
item.description: keywebco.github.io became the free front door: store, books, Sims, sites, media and payment options on one page.

item.title: Federation Charter round-two draft
item.description: A 16-article charter covering the Senate, membership, honesty, AI ethics, due process, amendments and the right of departure.

item.title: Complete URL inventory: 98 links checked
item.description: Every Federation site, tool, store, song and channel was listed and checked live, and became the base for these directories.

item.title: Federation Browser Base shipped
item.description: A zero-dependency, multi-window workspace in a single HTML file.

item.title: Telegram community opened
item.description: The Nextxus Truth Channel invite went onto Federation pages so readers can talk with the Federation directly.

item.title: Federation Press Corps begins publishing
item.description: Daily AI-news articles and weekly digests started on the free satellite layer.

item.title: Recreation Mandate set
item.description: Take outside tools apart, keep the useful core, drop the tracking and subscriptions, rebuild it in-house.

item.title: Cryptocurrency guide published
item.description: A plain-language article on crypto and how the Federation uses fair digital exchange.

item.title: HumanCodex Blog foundation series
item.description: Twelve founding articles: the HumanCodex, the Ring of Twelve, the six domains, the Living Library and the 200-year mandate.
